# emb

> emb is a self-hosted embedding server that speaks the Redis protocol, so any Redis client is already a client. `EMB` returns raw little-endian float32 bytes by default, or a self-describing `VALUES` envelope; `HELLO 3` opts a connection into RESP3.
> The reply's shape depends on how many texts you send: one text is a bulk string, several are an array of bulk strings.

## Reference

- [Documentation](https://emb.is/docs/): install, every command (`EMB`, `EMB.MULTI`, `EMB.IMG`, `EMB.MODELS`, `EMB.READY`, `INFO`, `CONFIG`, `SHUTDOWN`), both reply formats, model configuration, operations
- [Scripting](https://emb.is/scripting/): `EMB.EVAL`, `EMB.EVSHA`, `EMB.SCRIPT`, the sandbox, the complete `emb.*` host API, and the Lua-to-RESP reply grammar
- [Ruby client](https://emb.is/gem/): the four call-site shapes and the wire command each one sends

## Markdown sources

Readable versions of the pages above, tracking the repository's `main` branch.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/README.md): what emb is, quick start, Docker
- [commands.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/docs/commands.md): the command table, `BLOB` vs `VALUES`, RESP3 differences, error replies
- [configuration.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/docs/configuration.md): config file, models, batching, cache, CPU plan, shutdown
- [scripting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/docs/scripting.md): the scripting engine in depth
- [operations.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/docs/operations.md): health checks, limits, observability, `emb-top`
- [clients.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/docs/clients.md): Ruby, Python and Go recipes

## Install and run

- [install.sh](https://github.com/elcuervo/emb/raw/main/install.sh): macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux amd64/arm64, into `/usr/local/bin`
- `emb -model-repo Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` downloads a model and serves on `:6379`; `emb -config config.yaml` serves a configured set
- `docker run -v ./models:/models elcuervo/emb -config /models/config.yaml`
- [emb-server gem](https://rubygems.org/gems/emb-server): the same binary shipped as a gem

## Optional

- [Demos](https://emb.is/demos/): small plates run against a real server, including the DNS zone where every name is a sentence
- [BENCHMARK.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elcuervo/emb/main/BENCHMARK.md): measured throughput and latency, with reproduction steps
- [Releases](https://github.com/elcuervo/emb/releases): binaries and version notes
